_comment: What this bundle ships and which gates it can decide by itself. kind 'scan' means a script here answers it when pointed at a project root; kind 'suite' means the bundle names the rule but the project has to write its own test — those are reported as pending, never as passed. Some shipped files are neither: gates_doctor.py, preflight.py, lint_commits.py and check_issue_handoff.py are tools a project runs with context only its CI has (a commit range, a pull request number), so they take flags rather than a root and the doctor does not run them. The rules they enforce are published in rules.yaml like any other.

actions-sha-pinned.title: Every action is pinned to a commit SHA with the version in a comment
actions-sha-pinned.born_from: Tags move, commits do not — upload-artifact once sat on @v4 at a single call site for ten days with CI green throughout.

adr-index-complete.title: The ADR index covers every record, numbered without repeats or gaps · and supersessions are recorded in both directions
adr-index-complete.born_from: The index once stopped at 0026 while the files ran to 0033 — seven records from the phase that decided the biggest questions, invisible · audit round 14 added the second direction: ADR 0035 had superseded item 1 of 0032 since 2026-08-12, but 0032's own page did not know for seven days, while the module docstring at the head of app/audit.py still pointed at 0032 as the current mechanism, which CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids returning to.

ci-tools-hash-pinned.title: Tools CI installs for itself are pinned by hash, on both the Python and the Node side
ci-tools-hash-pinned.born_from: An unpinned install command takes whatever is newest at the second the job runs, and it runs with our workflow's privileges · pinning one package at a time pins only that package while the rest of the tree still floats.

csp-no-inline.title: CSP is pure self — no inline script, style, or handler anywhere
csp-no-inline.born_from: ADR 0010 — the browser blocks inline content silently with no server-side error, so the gate has to read the template files directly rather than wait for symptoms.

delete-means-soft-delete.title: Delete means hide (soft delete) — only purge removes rows for real
delete-means-soft-delete.born_from: ADR 0014 — a `--dry-run` implemented as a rollback once deleted real data, because purge committed before the savepoint closed · so there must be exactly one place that can delete.

gates-registry-total.title: The gate index matches reality in both directions, and every test file is accounted for
gates-registry-total.born_from: semgrep was scanning only 71 of 136 files because its scope was declared in two places — an index nothing holds to reality is an index that quietly reports things that are not true · audit round 7 added another field (`guards:` — ADR 0062): a gate that is expensive and has never caught anything has to be able to say *which path* it earns its keep on, or the question "is it still worth it" is answered by feel every time.

image-digest-pinned.title: The base image is pinned to a manifest-index digest and Dependabot moves it
image-digest-pinned.born_from: Pinning with nobody to move it freezes the vulnerabilities in place — the two must always arrive together, and the test enforces that the pair is not separated.

logic-knows-no-http.title: All logic lives in the service layer and knows nothing about HTTP
logic-knows-no-http.born_from: Phase 3 — logic buried in routes makes the HTML and the API diverge the instant a second adapter exists · an AST scan forbids services importing anything from the request side.

no-debug-entrypoint.title: No entrypoint file can open a debug console, even when the wrong one is run
no-debug-entrypoint.born_from: The first SAST round pointed at an entrypoint that could enable debug and was being copied into the image — run the wrong one and you have a debug console that executes code from a web page.

_requires_why: Shipped files are stdlib-only so they run in a project that has installed nothing. preflight.py is the exception: it reads whole workflow files, which the narrow subset reader in the scans cannot do, and it runs on a developer's machine rather than a bare CI runner. The dependency is declared here so a target project learns it from the bundle instead of from a traceback, and a test holds this list to what the files actually import.
